title: 3779. Minimum Number of Operations to Have Distinct Elements

examples.explanation: In the first operation, we remove the first three elements. The remaining elements [6, 5, 8] are all distinct, so we stop. Only one operation is needed.
After one operation, the array becomes empty, which meets the stopping condition.
All elements in the array are distinct, therefore no operations are needed.
